verdict.rationale: Whether source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a cloud storage service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows OneDrive's source being published under any license. The pack covers only proprietary Microsoft Graph APIs, published metadata and developer sandboxes, none of which is source code under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
